name: LuviaEdu – School Management System
author: sparkigniter

sections.description:
LuviaEdu is a complete School ERP and Academic Management System designed for modern educational institutions. It provides a highly interactive, unified React dashboard for administrators and teachers to coordinate student admissions, academic directories, financial transactions, class schedules, and student attendance.

Key Features:
* Academic Directory: Comprehensive student profile roster, class registration, and academic section management.
* Attendance System: Quick-action student attendance register with visual indicators and logs.
* Financial Ledger & Billing: Professional invoices, expense tracking, payroll processing, and student fee templates.
* Interactive Drag-and-Drop Form Builder: Easily design custom student registration or feedback forms.
* Dynamic Certificate Builder: Create, print, and distribute school certificates with ease.

Source Code & Build Tools

The unminified React source code and Vite compilation tools for the frontend dashboard of this plugin are publicly available at:
https://github.com/sparkigniter/luviaedu
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire luviaedu folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip file directly via the WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the LuviaEdu Command Center from your WordPress admin dashboard to start the Onboarding Setup Wizard.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Added onboarding seed customization options.
  • Implemented premium error pages (404 Space Orbit, 403 Principal Keycard, 500 Reactor Leak).
  • Fixed roster hover scaling bug.
  • Production security compile checks resolved.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
